headline: Local Man Rebrands 'Artificial Intelligence' As 'Authentic Knowing' To Fool His Smart Toaster
body: After reading that 'artificial' sounds too fake, a suburban resident has spent the morning editing his smart-home settings to 'Authentic Knowing' in hopes that his toaster will finally stop burning the sourdough. He insists that by removing the implication of synthetic origin, his appliances will now intuitively grasp the concept of a perfect golden-brown crisp.
caption: It’s not artificial if you refuse to believe it is. The power of branding strikes again in the kitchen. #Innovation #TechLife #SmartHome #Mindset (satire)
igHook: What’s the most ridiculous thing you’ve ever renamed to make it sound more professional?
imagePrompt: A close-up shot of a modern kitchen appliance screen with a digital menu where the text 'Authentic Knowing' is clearly visible as a selected setting.

sourceHeadline.title: Trump Renames AI To "Super Intelligence", Says 'Artificial' Sounds Fake
